scope: Read-only candidate review; no live operations

findings.finding: Snapshot diffs precede repository filter rejection; configured clean/process filters may execute during configure/status.
PR publish does not bind current repository and branch to reviewed identity.
PR publish fails to compare remote base OID with reviewed base OID.
Deleted symlinks and index symlink/gitlink modes can bypass unsupported path checks.
Inherited Git environment may redirect repository/index/config or execute SSH command.
Index CAS hashes staged listing, not complete raw index state including flags/extensions.
Review output accepts 4MiB while apply request is bounded to 2MiB.
Post-update-ref status failure needs truthful committed/uncertain outcome and reachability metadata.
Reconfiguring repository leaves commit and PR review panels actionable.
